headline: Approved bridge, sewer, and equipment bid actions and two engineering task orders.
summary: The committee approved minutes from the prior meeting, rejected and authorized rebidding on several projects including the Bridge St. Bridge Rehab, CSO Outfall Flow Metering Services, and a contractor trailer purchase. It also approved a change order for Continental Penstock and Upper Canal Repairs and authorized task orders with LJB Engineering and Wright-Pierce.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting dated August 24, 2026, 4-0.
Rejected the bid for the 2026-038 Bridge St. Bridge Rehab project and agreed to rebid it later, 5-0.
Ratified change order #1 for 2026-023 Continental Penstock and Upper Canal Repairs with Perryman Construction for $2,650, updating the estimated bid award to $650,395, 5-0.
Authorized the LJB Engineering task order for Jordan Road Bridge bypass design and permitting services, not to exceed $84,529, 5-0.
Rejected all bids for 2026-049 CSO Outfall Flow Metering Services and agreed to rebid with updated specifications, 5-0.
Authorized the task order for Jepson Brook interceptor manhole rehabilitation design services with Wright-Pierce, not to exceed $63,500, 5-0.
Rejected all bids for 2026-048 for one enclosed contractor trailer for Public Works and agreed to rebid with updated specifications, 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: To approve the minutes of the previous meeting dated August 24, 2026, and to accept and place them on file by the Clerk.
To formally reject the received bid for the 2026-038 Bridge St. Bridge Rehab project and rebid the project at a later date.

To ratify 2026-023 Continental Penstock and Upper Canal Repairs, change order #1, adding the masonry shoring and widening the infill wall to 2' into the scope of the project with Perryman Construction for a lump sum of $2,650 and an updated estimated bid award of $650,395.
To authorize the LJB Engineering task order for the Jordan Road Bridge bypass design and permitting services for an amount not to exceed $84,529.
To reject all bids for 2026-049 CSO Outfall Flow Metering Services and rebid the service with updated bid specifications after discussions with responding firms.
To authorize the task order for Jepson Brook interceptor manhole rehabilitation design services with Wright-Pierce for an amount not to exceed $63,500.

To reject all bids received for 2026-048 for one (1) enclosed contractor trailer for Public Works, and to rebid the purchase with updated bid specifications for the cabinet portion of the proposal form.

plain_text:
FINANCE COMMITTEE 
Lewiston, ME 
Minutes of  
September 14, 2026 
 
PRESENT: Chairman Chittim, Councilor Nagine, Mr. Bouh, Ms. McCabe, and Ms. Hoskins  
 
ABSENT: N/A 
 
OTHERS PRESENT: Deputy Director of Budget and Purchasing, Allen Ward , City Engineer, 
Jeff Beaule, and Fleet Operations Manager, Phil Brienza 
  
The meeting was called to order at 5:30 p.m.  
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(132-2026) To approve the minutes of the previous meeting dated August 24, 2026, and to accept 
and place them on file by the Clerk. 
 
VOTE: 4-0 
 
Councilor Nagine arrived at 5:32 p.m. 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(133-2026) To formally reject the received bid for the 2026 -038 Bridge St. Bridge Rehab project 
and rebid the project at a later date. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(134-2026) To ratify 2026-023 Continental Penstock and Upper Canal Repairs, change order #1, 
adding the masonry shoring and widening the infill wall to 2’ into the scope of the project with 
Perryman Construction for a lump sum of $2,650 and an updated estimated bid award of $650,395. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(135-2026) To authorize the LJB Engineering task order for the Jordan Road Bridge bypass design 
and permitting services for an amount not to exceed $84,529. 
 
VOTE: 5-0
FINANCE COMMITTEE                                                                             September 14, 2026 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(136-2026) To reject all bids for 2026 -049 CSO Outfall Flow Metering Services and rebid the 
service with updated bid specifications after discussions with responding firms. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(137-2026) To authorize the task order for Jepson Brook interceptor manhole rehabilitation design 
services with Wright-Pierce for an amount not to exceed $63,500. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(138-2026) To reject all bids received for 2026 -048 for one (1) enclosed contractor trailer for 
Public Works, and to rebid the purchase with updated bid specifications for the cabinet portion of 
the proposal form. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On motion of Chairman Chittim, seconded by Mr. Bouh, 
 
VOTED: 
To adjourn at 6:09 p.m.     
 
              ___________________________________ 
                                      Allen Ward 
                                                                    Clerk  
        Finance Committee
